recipe.visualDefinition: A retro-futuristic composition featuring a textured cyan-blue circular platform with architectural geometric protrusions, overlaid with thin neon-pink technical crosshairs and a sphere, set against a dark, grainy background.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon pink linear elements contrasting against heavy cyan geometric masses
Soft airbrushed gradients meeting sharp technical line work
Isometric 3D shapes interacting with flat 2D graphic overlays
Rough stippled texture of the main object against a smooth dark void

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, textured cyan disc dominates the center-right, tilted in an isometric perspective.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central neon pink crosshair intersection acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal pink script in the top left, moves down the vertical text on the right, and settles on the central geometric assembly.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark grey space surrounds the central object, providing high contrast for the neon elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue for the primary geometric structures and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the background to provide depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink/magenta for the script, crosshairs, and fine details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon accents against mid-tone cyan and low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left text: Fluid, continuous-line script with varying stroke weight and sharp terminals.
Right-side text: Vertical stack of narrow, monospaced sans-serif capitals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'S' features a dramatic, elongated tail that underlines the word.
Vertical text is spaced widely to emphasize the height of the composition.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, organic script with rigid, vertical geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Thin line weight for technical overlays

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, technical verticality required for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an isometric 3D scene with a large, stippled cyan-blue disc. Add a raised wedge and a sphere on top. Light the scene from the left to create long shadows. The background should be a dark, grainy charcoal grey. Overlay thin neon-pink crosshairs and a circle centered on the disc.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large neon-pink brush script in the top left corner at a slight upward angle. Add a vertical column of light cyan, narrow sans-serif capital letters on the right side, spaced widely.

verificationChecks: Is the script color a vibrant neon pink?
Is the secondary text stacked vertically on the right?
Does the central object have a grainy, airbrushed texture?
Are the technical crosshairs thin and precise?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
Copyright/Disc logos in the bottom left

avoid: Modern flat vector look without texture
3D rendering that looks too clean or digital

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text does not overlap the central geometric shapes.
Check that the vertical text is perfectly aligned.
Verify the grain texture is visible on the cyan surfaces.
Confirm the background is dark enough to make the neon pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Isometric Geometric Object] + [Airbrush Texture] + [Neon Pink Script] + [Technical Crosshair Overlay] + [Vertical Sans-Serif Typography] to recreate the 80s tech-noir aesthetic.
